runtime: Python standard library; bundled Python for real-data analysis

sms.attribution: Almeida, T. and Hidalgo, J. (2011), SMS Spam Collection, UCI Machine Learning Repository
sms.record_unit: one physical line containing label, first TAB separator, and message
sms.normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, all Unicode whitespace runs collapsed to ASCII space, strip
sms.near_duplicate_diagnostic: same normalized message after replacing each Unicode digit run by <NUM>; diagnostic only, does not change frozen partition
sms.conflicting_label_policy: quarantine the complete normalized group; preserve all source rows and partition assignment
sms.time_policy: no chronology or sender grouping inferred; corpus order and source-member provenance are not reliable time/source labels

incidents.attribution: Amaral, C., Fantinato, M. and Peres, S. (2018), Incident management process enriched event log, UCI Machine Learning Repository
incidents.group_unit: exact incident identifier number; no trimming or merging identifier values
incidents.timezone: unknown; compare recorded naive local timestamps only; never label UTC
incidents.temporal_feature_policy: all fields remain unaudited for online prediction; reconciliation uses visible record prefixes only; do not infer collection-time availability from enrichment
incidents.duplicate_policy: retain all rows; equal visible events need not be duplicate real events
incidents.order_policy: do not sort or repair raw rows; count within-incident time/counter regressions, equal-key conflicts, and future outcome fields; ambiguous real chronology remains unresolved

split.bucket: integer value of first 16 hexadecimal digest characters modulo 10000
split.manifest: one canonical JSON line per group, sorted by group digest, containing only digest, partition, source row numbers and eligibility
split.row_numbers: one-based data records; CSV header excluded
split.immutability: freeze algorithm before data; store exact full manifest and hash after first intake; never rebalance using labels or outcomes
split.near_duplicate_rule: cross-partition digit-template overlap blocks semantic-generalization scoring until a separately frozen leakage-safe evaluation subset is defined without observing model scores

network_policy: current environment denies UCI browser access and terminal network; this runner is offline-only and cannot fetch, redirect, upload, or bypass restrictions
intake_requirements: official archive locally supplied by an authorized route
per-lane provenance JSON with source page, actual official archive URL, retrieval time/method, archive SHA256 and source-page snapshot SHA256
local source-page snapshot containing CC BY 4.0 link
human review of bundled terms before baselines
archive_policy: read ZIP members in memory; reject traversal, absolute/drive/backslash paths, symlinks, encryption, duplicate names, unlisted names and bounds violations; never extract or execute archive files
license_policy: record official source license and bundled terms hash/flags; flag apparent restrictions for review, never silently override them; no raw source redistribution
quality_checks: cross-version schema drift explicitly unavailable without a second source snapshot
replacement_policy: do not replace a source because access permission is denied or outcomes are unfavorable; if authorized intake establishes missing official archive, incompatible license or unusable schema for the chosen task, preserve rejection and select at most one replacement under PUBLIC_WORKFLOW_SELECTION_PROTOCOL.md before observing scores
output_policy: raw archives, source-page snapshots and any bundled raw text stay in ignored data directory; tracked outputs contain provenance/hashes, aggregate counts, split row references and no message bodies, phone numbers, embedded URLs or person identifiers
admission: preflight tests may pass while real-data intake remains not executed; quality completion is not baseline admission, a benchmark win, a pilot, or either mission gate
